contributors.relationship: Everyone Wants Her as Their Best Friend

items.name: Vibing to Taylor Swift
items.reason: Singing our hearts out like every single bridge was written specifically for our personal drama. Zero shame, maximum emotional resonance.

items.name: You, me & Naina all gossiping together
items.reason: The unofficial board of directors meeting. 3+ hours vanishing into unfiltered debriefs, top-tier tea, and the sisters-I-didn't-get-at-home package.

items.name: Bonding over the worldly struggles of being Mulank 3
items.reason: The heavy cosmic burden of being ambitious, creative, slightly chaotic, and universally misunderstood by anyone whose birth date doesn't sum to 3.

items.name: Routine chicken biryani cravings
items.reason: Not a craving. A calling. A biological need that arrives at the same hour, hits the same way, and cannot be reasoned with. The only dish that makes life feel genuinely manageable.

items.name: The plans everyone else calls delusion
items.reason: The world tour. The travel blog. The Airbnb in a coastal town. The fashion that costs what it costs. We are not being delusional — we are simply early. And we both know it's all happening.

items.name: Love for a good romcom
items.reason: We will pause a documentary to dissect the meet-cute in a romcom we've both already seen three times. Zero shame. The genre understood something the rest of the world is still catching up to.
